name: tumr
description: Your Android app (Kotlin/Java, Flutter, React Native/Expo) on a live emulator: status, problems with file:line, screenshots, taps, reloads.
long_description: Needs Toolchain Universal Mobile Runtime installed on the PC (https://github.com/Jishnu2608/TUMR/releases). This bundle only starts its MCP server: it finds tumr.exe in the default install folder, through TUMR_EXE, or on PATH, and connects itself to the runtime on first use.
